notes: GiB uses 2^30 bytes. Whole-device peaks are sampled every 0.5 seconds and may miss short peaks.
RSS scope is explicit per case; summed descendant RSS may count shared pages more than once. Older script sampling covered only its launcher.
Initial native-22 and upscale-k0-22 cases lack whole-device/RSS samples.
Builds evolved during the campaign; final early-rejection guards do not change accepted short-case arithmetic. See the acceptance report for identities.
The 204-output gate was initially deferred under the duration cap; the subsequent explicit user request authorized the unchanged full gate, which passed all 204 hashes. Golden files remain unchanged.
Earlier broad host invocations created overlong synthetic FFmpeg fixtures; those invocations are excluded from bounded acceptance and disclosed in the report.
The 5/10/15-second cases at the new maximum canvases and continuation above 1344x768 are host-only. Optional 39-frame portrait and K=3/K=4 cases were not run.
